Reproducibility

Verification and provenance

The library and its independent statement compile with Lean 4.35.0-rc3. Their axiom reports contain only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. The three deliberate Challenge placeholders are not part of the proof.

October 29, 2026 (Lean v4.35.0-rc3, module system): fresh build passed (2347 jobs including Challenge and Solution); axiom audit passed with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, and a scan of all 2921 declarations found no other axiom. lake comparator check of the independent statement of Theorem A, Corollary B and Corollary 5.6 passed, with con-ron, NanoDa and Lean kernel replay.

Build the project

lake exe cache get
lake build
python3 scripts/audit_axioms.py
python3 scripts/generate_challenge.py --check
lake build Challenge Solution

Once Mathlib is fetched from the cache, a fresh build of the library takes a few minutes on a desktop machine. Build Challenge Solution before independent comparison with scripts/verify-comparator.sh.
